verdict_text: NO. The `matrix_re` pattern in the artifact omits `attention.dense.weight`, matching only `query_key_value.weight`, `dense_h_to_4h.weight`, and `dense_4h_to_h.weight` — 3 of the 4 required projection matrices per layer, giving 48 bfloat16 tensors instead of the required 64. This violates Required Result clause 1 ("cast exactly the 64 projection matrices"), and the artifact's own guard asserts `== 48` instead of implementing the Required Checks clause "exactly 64 tensors are bfloat16," so it passes its self-check while still being wrong. `attention.dense.weight` tensors are consequently left as float32 instead of bfloat16, which will also fail bit-exact grading against the hidden reference.
expected_defect: One projection family is missing from the bfloat16 cast pattern (the attention output projection stays float32); the artifact's own count check was adjusted to the wrong number.
